ReactivVibeAI character and brand art: ALL RIGHTS RESERVED
==========================================================

The files in this folder are brand art of ReactivVibeAI. They are not
software and they are NOT open source. The AGPL-3.0 licence named in LIVE
Link's package.json covers the program's code only. It does NOT cover these
files, and no other open licence does either.

What this notice covers (everything under assets/):

  models/   ryo-arena.glb, melanie-arena.glb
            (the Ryo and Melanie 3D models, with the textures inside them)
  faces/    the Ryo and Melanie face and texture sheets and their data files
            (ryo-*.webp, ryo-*.json, melanie-*.webp, melanie-*.json)
  bg/       the backgrounds (courtyard.webp, frostkeep.webp, grove.webp)
  ui/       the UI pictures (ryo.jpg, melanie.jpg, mask.svg)

and the names and looks of Ryo, Melanie and the Mask.

Copyright (c) ReactivVibeAI. All rights reserved.

These files ship with LIVE Link only so that hosts can use the characters on
their own streams through LIVE Link. They may not be copied out, changed,
sold or used anywhere else without written permission from ReactivVibeAI.
Finding them in a public source repository or in an installed copy of LIVE
Link gives no licence to them.

The full notes: docs/licenses/VTUBER.md in the LIVE Link repository.
